draft.subject: Re: your questions on invites, API limits and the badge
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for writing in -- answers to your two questions: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and if you'd rather not do them one by one, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file. On the 429s: API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter. Your notification badge ticket is still open and I'm tracking it.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first real project alongside you -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Best,
Priya
